welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.intro: This tool installs OpenWork on your computer.
welcome.credentials: You will be asked to enter your EPFL credentials to create or retrieve your LLM inference API key.

error.network: The EPFL network is not reachable. If you are off campus, connect to the EPFL VPN.
error.missingKey: No RCP key is available from the previous step.
error.openworkBroken: The OpenWork database blocks the start. Back it up and clear it, then retry the step.

login.waiting: A portal window is open. Log in with your EPFL account. The installation continues when you are logged in.

create.nameError: Use 1 to 15 characters from A-Z, a-z, 0-9, hyphen and underscore.

existingKeys.title: Or reuse one of your existing keys

choice.title: An OpenWork key already exists
choice.text: Your account may already have an OpenWork key. Reuse the existing key, or create a second key with a new name.

manual.title: Do it yourself in the browser
manual.intro: The portal window did not work. Create or copy the key in your browser, then paste the token.
manual.step1: Log in to the RCP portal with your EPFL account.
manual.step2: Create an OpenWork key, or copy the token of the existing key.
manual.step3: Paste the token in the field below.

error.provider: The OpenCode configuration was not written: {detail}

prereq.missingWebkit: webkit2gtk-4.1 is missing. OpenWork may not start. Install it with: sudo apt install libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev
prereq.missingFuse: libfuse2 is missing. The AppImage may not start. Install it with: sudo apt install libfuse2 (libfuse2t64 on Ubuntu 24.04)

openwork.missing: OpenWork is not installed on this computer.
openwork.stateBrokenDetail: OpenWork stops with the message: Database is not empty and has no session table.
openwork.stateBrokenCause: The cause is a database file that another engine version created. OpenWork expects its own layout in that file, so it stops at start.
openwork.stateBrokenFix: This setup can move the file to a backup and clear it. OpenWork then creates a new database on its next start. The backup keeps the old content, nothing is deleted.
openwork.stateConsent: I agree that this setup moves the database file to a backup.

summary.title: Summary
summary.smokeSkipped: The engine check was skipped because no OpenWork engine was found. The installation is complete.
